📣 Are you ready to kick-start your backend engineering career building smart products with modern Java, Spring Boot, and cloud technologies?
 If you enjoy writing clean code, exploring DevSecOps and Microsoft Azure practices, and growing within a collaborative engineering team, this role is for you.
 Our philosophy is “First who, then what.”
 📍 This role is hybrid with 3 days on site in Bucharest.
 🚀 First who? 
You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
You have foundational knowledge of modern Java (17+), Spring Boot (3+), SQL, and Git.
You are familiar with API concepts (OpenAPI/Swagger), OAuth2 fundamentals, and testing frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito).
You have basic notions of cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure) and DevOps tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab pipelines).
You bring a proactive, detail-oriented mindset with a strong focus on code quality and security best practices.
You are a collaborative team player eager to learn, take initiative, and grow in a software engineering role.
 🚀 Then what? 
You’ll contribute to designing, building, testing, and deploying extensible backend solutions for smart products.
You’ll apply clean code and DevSecOps principles while maintaining high automated test coverage.
You’ll sharpen your cloud, containerization, and modern engineering skills alongside supportive development teams.
 📌 Your mission 
Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable backend software solutions
Build reusable and extensible components following Inner Source best practices
Apply clean code principles and develop automated unit and functional test suites (ensuring 80%+ coverage)
Integrate security and compliance principles across the development lifecycle
Monitor and optimize system performance and application reliability
Collaborate with engineering teams to improve software delivery workflows and stay current with modern DevOps tools
 ⚙️ Your toolbox Technical Skills 
Java 17+ & Spring Boot 3+
SQL & Relational Databases
OpenAPI / Swagger & OAuth2 Concepts
Testing Frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito)
Git & Version Control
Microsoft Azure Cloud Fundamentals
Basic notions of Python 3+, Docker & Kubernetes
Basic notions of CI/CD & Quality Tools (GitLab pipelines, Sonar, Artifactory, Flyway)
Software Engineering or Cloud Certifications - plus
Data-oriented mindset - plus
 General Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
High attention to detail and focus on software quality
Proactivity, autonomy, and eagerness to embrace new practices
Good communication and collaborative spirit
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the First who and see yourself thriving in the Then what ?
 👉 Apply now and let’s talk.
